command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
# ROOT needs a writable HOME and no display, or it fails early and opaquely.
export DISPLAY=
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# Pin BLAS/OpenMP threads so the seeded fit is reproducible run to run.
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
# Stage the ROOT file's size out too: the format round-trip is the headline, so evidence
# that a real file was written belongs in the record.
test -s /tmp/out.root && printf 'root_file_bytes\t%s\n' "$(stat -c %s /tmp/out.root)" >> identities.log
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
